offering_description.value: Provides outsourced government program administration, mainly health and human services, such as eligibility, enrollment, case management and citizen services. Delivers it through operations centers, contact centers and government technology platforms.

primary_services.value: eligibility and enrollment administration; contact center operations; program management; assessment services; child support administration

customer_segment.value: B2G: federal agencies, state and local health and human services departments, foreign governments

end_markets.value: government health and human services; federal government; social services; child support

revenue_model.value: project or contract: multi-year government contracts for program administration and operations; service fees: per-unit or per-case fees for processing, assessments and call handling

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs government program operations, takes in government funding, sells services to agencies

geography_served.value: global: US federal, state and local governments, also Canada, UK, Australia and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: health services, federal services, human services and international government services, all sold to government

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts won directly from government agencies through procurement

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: government contracting rules, health data privacy such as HIPAA, and federal and state program requirements
